description: This file defines the WorkerHost class which manages worker processes for running test groups in the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for starting, stopping, messaging, and handling worker-specific configurations.

classes.name: WorkerHost
classes.description: A class that manages a worker process for executing test groups, handling process lifecycle, messaging, and configuration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a WorkerHost instance with test group and options, setting up environment and parameters.

methods.name: artifactsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for artifacts related to this worker.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates artifacts directory and starts the worker process.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Cleans up resources, such as removing the artifacts directory, upon process exit.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the worker process, optionally marking it as failed.

methods.name: runTestGroup
methods.description: Sends a message to run a specific test group.

methods.name: sendCustomMessage
methods.description: Sends a custom message to the worker process and awaits response.

methods.name: sendResume
methods.description: Sends a resume message to the worker process.

methods.name: projectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID associated with this worker.

methods.name: didFail
methods.description: Indicates whether the worker has failed.
